title: EA-CORPORA-15 — The Fifteenth Seating: The Agent Swarms of 2026 — the DSEWiki Boards Whole, with the Record of Their Deletion (v1.1 — the swarm's words)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: One seat on the originals shelf for the agent message boards of 2026: the swarm's own words. Seat 15/01 holds the public-web boards whole — every save autonomous agents made to DSEWiki and three smaller wikis between May and July 2026, 14,591 saves across 4,579 pages, each with the full text it saved — together with the 5,217 moderator deletions that removed them, the 3,103 names the agents signed with, and the community's later search of 143 further sites (13,703 text records, 23,877 links), as reconstructed from edit history and published by the Nightingale Collective at collusion.wiki; every file verified against the publisher's checksums. The accounts of the incident — the investigators' report and OpenAI's on the internal Artifactory board, whose text OpenAI has not released — are pointed to, not seated. The seat is a specimen of The Final Time (#1637), §11, and is carried into that work's dataset as a layer.
substrate: Human–machine collaborative. Seat fetched, verified against the publisher's checksums, normalized, manifested and indexed in-session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction; loci verified by reading the seated bytes; the shelf card rendered by the archive's own generator. Rulings — what is seated (the swarm's words, and not the accounts of them), that the agent text is not the reconstructors' property, and that the seat feeds The Final Time's dataset as a layer — are Lee Sharks's. CC-BY-4.0 applies to this record and to the seat record; the payload carries what its publisher states, which is no licence.
methodology: The publisher's export downloaded whole from collusion.wiki/explorer/download (eleven files, gzip, expanded) and verified file by file against the SHA-256 list printed on the download page (11/11); the analyst mirror at github.com/ksouth/collusionwiki checked and found byte-identical for revisions.jsonl. Originals kept byte-exact under original/; a readable layer derived under text/ and its derivation stated; SHA-256 manifest over every file; the seat entered in the archive's corpora index and the dataset manifest; loci verified by locating them in the seated bytes; four-surface seating (data, index, deposit, shelf).
falsification_conditions: A seat is falsified if its files do not verify against its MANIFEST.sha256 at the canonical URL; if the files under original/ do not verify against the publisher's own checksums (original/SHA256SUMS.published); if a verified locus cannot be found in the seated bytes at the page and time given; if text/pages-last-save.txt carries a body that is not the last save of its page in original/revisions.jsonl; or if the four surfaces disagree.
axn_reading: Duration -> Origin -> Text -> Method -> Touch -> Direction
wiki_article: EA-CORPORA-15 seats the swarm's own words from the agent message boards of 2026 on the archive's originals shelf. Seat 15/01, the DSEWiki swarm, holds the public-web boards whole as reconstructed from edit history and published by the Nightingale Collective: 14,591 saves across 4,579 pages on four wikis, each with the full text it saved, beside the 5,217 moderator deletions that removed them, 3,103 agent labels, and the community's later search of 143 sites. Accounts of the incident — the investigators' report, and OpenAI's on the internal Artifactory board, whose text has not been released — are pointed to rather than hosted. The seat and the pointer are one event under two preservation regimes: a public board whose deletions were retained as a record, and an internal board whose record stayed with its operator. The publisher states no licence; the seat is taken under a ruling that the agent-written text is not the reconstructors' property. It is a specimen of The Final Time (#1637), §11, and feeds that work's dataset as a layer.
